name: Agnimon
look: a warrior of flame in red armour over black, a golden mane streaming back, gold trim and flames at its wrists and ankles
entry: A warrior of flame in red armour, born from the spirit of fire. It fights with blazing fists and kicks, and its spinning dance of flame burns away any evil.
how: Wild: uncommon in badlands, volcanic biomes, savannas, mountains and hills.
